descricao: SHAP of y_lag1 (the AR feature with the highest mean |SHAP| at h = 1) against its value; orange = target date is a Saturday.
metodo: XGBoost native TreeSHAP: Booster.predict(DMatrix(X), pred_contribs=True); contributions on the log-margin scale of count:poisson (forecast = exp(base + sum of contributions))
escala: log-margin of count:poisson; forecast (admissions/day) = exp(base + sum of SHAP); a contribution phi multiplies the forecast by exp(phi)

parametros.regra: AR feature with the highest mean |SHAP| at h = 1 (resumo_importancia.csv)

status: demonstration, not a dissertation result; provisional
